items.source: Return the required ResolvableType of the missing bean, if it was a lookup by type that failed.
items.translation: 返回缺失 Bean 所需的ResolvableType（如果失败的是按类型查找）。

items.source: name - the name of the missing bean
type - required type of the missing bean
items.translation: type - 缺失 Bean 的必需类型

items.source: type - full type declaration of the missing bean
items.translation: type - 缺失 Bean 的完整类型声明

items.source: Exception thrown when a BeanFactory is asked for a bean instance for which it cannot find a definition. This may point to a non-existing bean, a non-unique bean, or a manually registered singleton instance without an associated bean definition.
items.translation: 当请求一个无法找到定义的 Bean 实例时，会抛出异常。这可能指向不存在的 Bean、非唯一的 Bean，或是一个没有关联 Bean 定义的手动注册单例实例。

items.source: Return the name of the missing bean, if it was a lookup by name that failed.
items.translation: 如果失败的是按名称查找，则返回缺失 Bean 的名称。

items.source: Return the required type of the missing bean, if it was a lookup by type that failed.
items.translation: 返回缺失 Bean 所需的类型，如果它是失败的按类型查找。

items.source:
Return the number of beans found when only one matching bean was expected.
For a regular NoSuchBeanDefinitionException, this will always be 0.
items.translation: 返回找到的 Bean 数量，而预期只找到一个匹配的 Bean。对于普通的 NoSuchBeanDefinitionException，此值始终为 0。

items.source: Rod Johnson, Juergen Hoeller, Stephane Nicoll
items.translation: Rod Johnson、Juergen Hoeller 和 Stephane Nicoll

items.source: Return the number of beans found when only one matching bean was expected.
items.translation: 返回找到的 Bean 数量，而预期只有一个匹配的 Bean。
